description.raw: Zandrok raises his axe and slams down on the enemy, destroying all obstacles within 2 tiles of their position. The impact deals 12% (HP-based) + 2% (SP-based) damage to enemies in the area nd knocks them in the air for 1s.

description.raw: Passive. When a battle starts, Zadrok summons illusions of himself that charge forward in a 5-tile-wide wedge formation toward the enemy side, dealing 10% (HP-based) damage and destroying all obstacles in their path. Any allies they pass through, including Zandrok, become inspired. Inspired Zandrok and allies gain 50% + 5% (SP-based) and 20% + 2% (SP-based) extra max HP respectively until the battle ends, with their current HP remaining unchanged. They also increase their Life Drain by 40 + 4 (SP-based), Haste by 20, and movement speed by 100% for 8s. Active. Zandrok inspires his allies within 2 tiles, increasing their Life Drain by 25 + 4 (SP-based) and Haste by 14 for 8s. Unstackable.
